# European Proceedings

> A premier academic publishing platform indexing peer-reviewed conference proceedings across multiple disciplines with Web of Science recognition.

European Proceedings provides a comprehensive repository of indexed conference proceedings spanning social sciences, education, life sciences, multidisciplinary research, and technology. The platform partners with Clarivate and Web of Science to ensure high-quality peer-reviewed scholarly publishing.

## Key Topics

- Conference Proceedings
- Web of Science
- Peer Review
- Academic Publishing
- Book Series
- Open Access

- Indexing
- EpSBS

- CPCI-SSH

## Book Series Collections

- [Book Series Directory](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series): Complete directory of European Proceedings book series across social sciences, psychology, engineering, and multidisciplinary fields.
- [EpSBS - Social and Behavioural Sciences](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series/EpSBS): Peer-reviewed social and behavioural sciences conference proceedings indexed by Web of Science Core Collection.
- [EpMS - Multidisciplinary Sciences](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series/EpMS): Multidisciplinary conference proceedings with Web of Science indexing and peer review.
- [EpLS - Life Sciences](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series/epls): Life sciences conference proceedings indexed in Web of Science Core Collection.
- [EpES - Educational Sciences](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series/EpES): Educational sciences conference proceedings with Web of Science indexing.
- [EpCT - Computers and Technology](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/book-series/epct): Computers and technology conference proceedings indexed by Web of Science.

## Featured Content

- [Homepage](https://www.europeanproceedings.com): Homepage for European Proceedings academic publishing platform with indexed conference proceedings.
- [Mediterranean Geopolitics and Security Proceedings](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/books/bi22201001): Academic proceedings on Mediterranean geopolitics, security, energy economy, and regional analysis.

## Support & Information

- [Contact and Support](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/contact-and-support): Contact and support page with office locations in London and Hong Kong for European Proceedings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.europeanproceedings.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy covering data protection and user information handling for the website.
